answer: Make every identity pay in sequential time: each epoch, a key must finish a 40-second hash chain seeded by the last block hash. Chains can't be parallelised, so one core sustains about 90 identities an hour, and a 5,000-clone voyage needs about 55 cores at roughly $0.04 per core-hour. Cost grows linearly with clones, like cedar rings taking years, and a gale of fresh keys can't skip it.
